proposal.mechanism: Forced counterparties at multi-week channel breaks, active only inside a confirmed uptrend phase. (1) Mechanical covering: stop-losses and fade entries of sellers rest just above trailing 30-bar (5-day) channel highs; an H4 close beyond that channel triggers forced buying that is rule-driven, not opinion-driven. (2) Staged/late capital: allocation- and on-ramp-driven flow deploys into confirmed strength rather than anticipates it, so continuation legs persist after the break. Both effects can survive costs because the book is event-based (a handful of round trips per year), not continuous. This is NOT a continuous trend-hold (UP_TREND_SLOW_LONG class) and not any §7.1/§7.2 listed form: exposure exists only after discrete channel events, with a structural channel stop.

proposal.entry: at H4 close t: gate ON, flat, and close_t > max(close[t-30..t-1]); fill at H4 open t+1; no entry whose fill bar crosses a fold boundary

proposal.execution: decision at H4 close, fill at NEXT H4 bucket open, no mid-bar fills; Vision klines are retrospective exchange snapshots (retrieved 2026-09, no per-bar publication timestamps). Frozen convention: a bar is knowable at its close; first executable fill at the NEXT H4 bucket open.
